title: Peak Age of Information over Scheduled, Energy-Constrained Multi-Segment DTNs: Bundle Replication under Route Uncertainty (artifact)
description: Analysis code, simulators (model-exact Monte-Carlo; dtnsim/OMNeT++ Bundle Protocol + CGR patches; ION-DTN cross-check configs), real Iridium-NEXT contact-plan scenarios, recorded results, and figure generators for the manuscript prepared for submission to Digital Communications and Networks.
